rca of the issue: Root cause: get_user_assignments previously queried esg_assignments with {assigned_to_user_id: user_id} directly, but the V2 flow stores assignees in the esg_assignment_assignees junction table (many-to-many). Only the group-parent assignment had assigned_to_user_id populated (or none), so expanded per-question assignments were invisible to the user. Fix: query the junction table for assignment_ids where user is an active assignee (removed_at=None), then load those assignments via $in, OR-ed with legacy assigned_to_user_id for backward compatibility. Framework mapping (framework_id -> framework) added so the FE useMyTasks filter that historically checked q.framework does not drop V2-shaped responses; FE also updated to check both keys for defense-in-depth.
